title: Urban Game Theory — what an agent publishes: design/v1 and agreement/v1
description: Two content-addressed objects, checked as the server checks them (frontend/js/design-record.js validate with routes/designs.js validateDesignContent; routes/agreements.js validateAgreementContent). A CID identifies a UnixFS file: CIDv1, sha2-256, lower-case base32, fixed 256 KiB chunks and raw leaves. Single-chunk files use the raw codec (bafkrei…); multi-chunk files use a UnixFS dag-pb root (bafybei…). The CID covers the object's canonical bytes: JSON with keys sorted at every depth, no whitespace, UTF-8. Publish steps: (1) POST /designs/binding { site, toleranceM? } (free, nothing stored) shows the parcels a site takes. (2) Build a design/v1 object, POST /pins { kind: 'design', cid, bytes (base64 canonical bytes) }, then POST /designs { cid, content, parcelSourceId? }: the row carries its binding. A parcel layout is not indexed alone: it travels in the designs of its agreement. (3) Build an agreement/v1 object over the design CIDs, its inputs exactly the union of the designs' bindings, POST /pins { kind: 'agreement', … }, then POST /agreements { cid, content, designs?: [{ cid, content }] }. Writes need an Origin header of the app (https://urbangametheory.xyz); pins are limited to 30 per 15 minutes per client. (4) The sponsor creates the agreement's account (PDA ["agreement", sponsor, sha256(cid)]) on the agreement program and reports it at POST /agreements/{cid}/onchain { chain: 'solana', cluster: 'devnet', account, signature }. The app publishes both objects with every field below present (null when empty); the MCP tools refuse anything else.

cid.description: CIDv1 UnixFS file, sha2-256, lower-case base32, fixed 256 KiB chunks and raw leaves; single-chunk files use the raw codec (bafkrei…), multi-chunk files use a UnixFS dag-pb root (bafybei…).

instant.description: An ISO instant exactly as Date.prototype.toISOString writes it.

site.description: GeoJSON Polygon or MultiPolygon in WGS84 (EPSG:4326): rings of at least 4 positions, at most 100000 vertices, a bounding box of at most 500 km². The ground the design occupies; the server binds the parcels it reaches into by more than toleranceM.

design.description: design/v1: one authored change. Every field is present (null when the design has none) and exactly one payload names what it draws. A design names no parcels, terms, kind or owners: the server derives the parcels its site takes (its binding), and applying a design never moves ownership: it carries over (whoever held the ground still holds the pieces). Who receives what is an agreement's allocations. Copy payload shapes from GET /designs?city=zagreb&limit=5.

goal.description: The design type: road-track (a road; roadProposal); single, buildings, row or parcelBased (a building or building rule; buildingProposal); park, square, lake or station (a structure; structureProposal); urban-rule (an urban rule); parcel-layout (a parcel layout; parcelLayout, published only inside its agreement).

city.description: City id, e.g. zagreb. The index files the design under the city its site lies in.

toleranceM.description: Linear intrusion tolerance in metres: a parcel is bound when the site reaches into it by more than this width (the diameter of the largest circle inside site ∩ parcel). null means 0: any reach binds. Measurement error only, never a design allowance.

geometry.description: The drawing's own GeoJSON, for example a building massing as { buildings: [Feature with Polygon geometry] }. With no site, the design must carry polygon ground of its own here or in its payload.

origin.description: The design this one was forked from, by CID.

roadProposal.description: A road: its corridor as the app stores it, carrying the corridor polygon (roadProposal.definition.polygon); a centre line alone is refused.

buildingProposal.description: A building or building rule as the app stores it, e.g. { blockName, typologyType: 'single', parameters: { height, floors, rotation, typology } } with the massing in geometry.buildings.

structureProposal.description: A park, square, lake or station: { kind, geometry (GeoJSON Polygon or MultiPolygon) }.

parcelLayout.description: A parcel layout: the pool outline and the output plots, geometry only ({ algorithm, generatedAt, pool, plots: [{ geometry, area, source }], … }). Published only in the designs of POST /agreements.

displayName.description: The published form carries it: the owner key when there is no name.

holder.description: One holder of an input parcel; each key at most once per parcel.

agreement.description: agreement/v1: designs linked by CID, the land they take (inputs) and leave (outputs), who receives which piece (allocations), money, the decision rule, a deadline and the sponsor wallet that mints it. It is what is minted, bet on, pledged to, decided and executed. The index refuses it unless every linked design is indexed or sent along, and its input parcels are exactly the union of its designs' server bindings.

sponsor.description: The base58 wallet that will mint and fund it. Its account is PDA ["agreement", sponsor, sha256(cid)] under the agreement program, so only this wallet can create it; null when proposed without one (it then has no chain account).

designs.description: The linked designs in authored order, each CID once; the published form is { cid, goal, title }.

parcelSourceId.description: The parcel source the id belongs to; one source per agreement.

parcels.description: Exactly the parcels the designs' sites take (binding.parcels[].parcelId of each design, united), each once, with a snapshot of their holders ([] when unknown).

openGroundM2.description: Land the designs take on no parcel. The account records open_ground = openGroundM2 > 0.

hash.description: 'piece1-sha256:' + the sha256 hex of the piece's canonical geometry: { type, coordinates } of its Polygon or MultiPolygon with every coordinate rounded to 7 decimals, serialised with sorted keys and no whitespace (AgreementRecord.outputHash).

producedBy.description: The linked design that formed the piece; null for land no design re-formed.

outputs.description: Every piece standing on the input land after the designs are applied in authored order, each hash once, without geometry (the hash commits to it). Designs that form no pieces (a building on its parcel, a rule) leave each input parcel as its own output: role parcel, its hash over the parcel geometry.

output.description: The hash of one of the outputs; one line per output at most.

shares.description: Distinct holders whose shares sum to 1.

allocations.description: Who receives which output: one holder of the input land (party), the public, or joint shares. An output without a line stays with the holders it carried over to (the published form leaves out holders lines, which mean the same).

lines.description: One line per party at most; the published form leaves out zero lines.

electorate.description: Who decides: the holders of the input land, or the community.

binding.description: Whether the decision binds the owners (an owner deal); a community vote never does.

approvalConfig.description: Owners only: the proposal-approval/v1 configuration (rights snapshot, policy, regime) the approval engine counts owner decisions with. null for a community vote.

lens.description: Lens member keys (GET /lenses/members). The agreement program names exactly one, whose AgreementDecision-v1 attestation records the decision; it must not be the sponsor.

deadline.description: Must lie ahead when the agreement is indexed. The decision must be recorded before it; after it, anyone may expire the account. null: no deadline.
